name: Generate original quotes by category and save a favourite
description: Verifies a category request returns usable original quotes and a favourite remains saved after refresh.
steps: Save one result as a favourite
Refresh the page and open Saved
expected: Generated quote cards appear and the selected favourite is still present in Saved after refresh.

name: Browse and search the imported classic quote archive
description: Verifies the uploaded quote collection is present, searchable, and its attribution metadata remains available when saved or designed.
steps: Confirm matching quotes show their citation details
Save one quote and open its design studio
expected: Matching imported quotes appear with their original source and citation details, and the selected quote can be saved and opened in the design studio.

name: Generate quotes from a custom topic and recover from invalid input
description: Verifies custom topics generate relevant quotes and invalid input is rejected with clear feedback.
steps: Generate quotes and inspect the results
Enter more than 100 characters and submit again
expected: Quotes relevant to the topic appear; overlong input shows validation feedback without clearing existing results.

name: Customize a quote design and export an image
description: Verifies the editor updates the preview and produces a downloadable quote image with its available attribution.
steps: Open the design studio for a quote
Choose a visual theme and change the text colour
expected: The preview reflects the selected design settings and a PNG download is initiated with the available author, citation and year credit.

name: Use the quote generator on a mobile viewport
description: Verifies the generation and classic archive search flows remain usable on a narrow screen.
steps: Open the generator on a mobile viewport
Generate a quote using the Success category
expected: The interface fits the mobile viewport, archive search remains usable, results are readable, and copy provides confirmation.
